fact: The NPC's Assistant Director of Civil Registration says a unique NIN is now generated for each child during birth registration and tied to the mother.
The NPC release quotes the First Lady on an initiative by NPC, NIMC and Barnksforte to issue a national identification number to every child at birth, starting in 2024.

The NPC chairman said the NIN has been integrated into the e-CRVS system and newborns can now receive a NIN at birth. Over 15,000 children registered in Jigawa have birth certificates processed for NIN generation, the chairman said.
UNICEF says the electronic birth registration initiative aims to link birth records with the National Identification Number so every child gets a verifiable legal identity from birth.
NPC, NIMC, UNICEF and ALGON adopted a work plan for phased rollout in eleven pilot states of ward-level points giving under-fives a birth certificate and a National Identification Number.
